sm_top.sm: Ukrainian maritime drones sank a Russian naval corvette in Benghazi port, prompting diplomatic fallout and compensation demands from Libya.
Iran denied involvement in a drone attack in Kuwait that killed two Italian nationals.
A funeral was held in Gaza for two security staff from Doctors Without Borders killed in an Israeli strike.
Saudi air defenses intercepted Houthi missiles and drones targeting Riyadh, causing damage to a tower.
The ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people, prompting international reactions and calls for accountability.
The US military disabled a merchant ship attempting to run a blockade of Iranian ports.
Saudi airstrikes in Yemen resulted in reported casualties, including at least 11 people killed.
Iran claimed it shot down a US drone near the Strait of Hormuz.
Italy warned it may reduce its aid to Ukraine following the reported port attack in Benghazi.
Houthis struck Saudi oil infrastructure as fighting in Yemen escalated.
Tankers were reported damaged or exploding after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
An attack on a Saudi refinery killed one worker and injured several others.
Houthi forces launched missiles targeting southern Saudi Arabia.
Drone and missile attacks across Ukraine resulted in casualties and injuries.
An explosion near a school in eastern Afghanistan killed and injured students.
Poland plans to establish a no-fly zone near its eastern border following Russian airspace violations.
President Zelenskyy warned that Russia is preparing a massive missile strike.
Ukraine reported hitting five Russian warplanes, including three MiG-31s and two Su-34s, at Savasleyka air base.
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected facilities and called for an expanded deployment of tactical nuclear weapons.
An airstrike by the Myanmar military on a wedding venue killed 17 people.
Drone attacks triggered fires at the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Refinery and the Samara oil hub in Russia.
A massive Ukrainian drone attack targeting Russia involved over 460 drones aimed at Moscow.
A Russian Aerospace Forces general was arrested following a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge.
Drone attacks on St. Petersburg disrupted Pulkovo airport operations and resulted in a reported injury and property damage.
Ukraine strikes the Crimean Bridge, disrupting Russian supply routes.
Russian MoD claims strikes hit energy and transport infrastructure in Ukraine.
Houthi attacks killed three people, including a child, in Yemen's Taiz.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps continued missile military maneuvers across several regions in Iran.
Ukrainian forces struck a ballistic missile fuel production plant in Russia's Tula Oblast.
Saudi-led airstrikes hit the Yemeni capital Sanaa in response to Houthi missile fire.
An armed group attack on a military compound in western Niger left 13 soldiers killed.
An airstrike on Sanaa injured at least 15 people while coalition forces intercepted a missile targeting Riyadh.
Russia targeted a Ukrainian cargo ship in the Black Sea and struck power plants amid reciprocal attacks.
Drone attacks across Ukraine resulted in reported casualties as Russia intercepted incoming drones.
Yemen's Houthis reported that coalition airstrikes killed 11 people, including children.
Communal clashes in Niger State, Nigeria, result in a death toll of 74.
An explosion near a school in eastern Afghanistan killed 7 people and injured 97 others.
A Russian military flotilla bound for Libya turned around following the sinking of a warship.
A missile was launched from Izeh, Khuzestan, as part of ongoing Iranian military exercises and missile tests.
The coalition stepped up airstrikes to weaken Houthi military capabilities.
